title: HustleBox v1.2.2 — The Climb (and the Exit)
message:
The career arc is real now.

NEW RANK SYSTEM
The generic Broke → Legend ladder is gone. You're climbing a real career inside Ray's truck:
• Dishwasher (start)
• Prep Cook
• Line Cook
• Head Cook
• Manager
• Owner (you bought the truck from Ray)

GRADUATION ENDING
Reach Owner and a letter shows up. Someone's been watching the truck — your hours, your reputation, your climb. They want you on their team. They don't say where. You start in about a week.
• Game stays fully playable after the ending fires.
• The ending shows ONCE — your save tracks that you've graduated, and the Profile shows your next-job date going forward.
• Profile reads 🎓 GRADUATED instead of 🏆 OWNER once it's done.

DYNAMIC STORY UPDATED
The profile story now mirrors the career ladder: bottom-of-the-rung dishwasher narrative at $0, prep-cook chopping narrative at $100, line cook at $1K, head cook at $10K, manager at $100K, owner at $1M. After graduation, a special epilogue paragraph.

HOME SCREEN — RAY'S TRUCK GRAPHIC
The top of the Home screen now shows Ray's truck parked on the curb at night — diamond plate body, glowing window, a tiny 'RAY'S' sign swinging on a string, stars overhead, smoke puffing from the side. Tap anywhere on the card to start a shift. If you've graduated, a 'last days here' caption shows your next-job date.

NEW WORK TAB ICON
The burger emoji in the bottom nav has been replaced with a crossed spatula + knife SVG icon for the Work tab. More food-truck, less ambient food. Also: removed the SOON badge from Friends in the bottom nav since friends is fully wired now.

No save data wiped. Existing players with progress past the Owner threshold will see the graduation ending on next launch — the trigger fires once and stores the date going forward.
